workgroup.description: Workgroup or domain name for Samba.

server_string.description: Description string displayed by `nmblookup` and other tools. %v is replaced with Samba version.

security.description: Security mode: 'user' for local accounts, 'domain' for NT domain, 'ads' for Active Directory.

map_to_guest.description: Controls when a user is mapped to the guest account (e.g., 'Bad User' when username is unknown).

log_file.description: Path for log files. %m expands to the client machine name.

max_log_size.description: Maximum size (in KB) of each log file before rotation.

dns_update_enabled.description: Enable DNS dynamic update support (required for AD DC mode).

items.description: List of VFS modules to enable globally for all shares. Common: 'recycle' for trash functionality, 'audit' for logging, 'quota' for disk quotas.

vfs_modules_global.description: Global list of VFS modules to load for every share.

name.description: Share name (used as section header, e.g., [documents]).

browseable.description: If true, the share appears in network browsing lists.

read_only.description: If true, users cannot write to the share (unless overridden with 'writable = yes').

guest_ok.description: Allow guest access to this share.

create_mask.description: Unix permission mask (octal) applied to new files.

directory_mask.description: Unix permission mask (octal) applied to new directories.

force_user.description: Force all file operations to run as this user (e.g., 'nobody').

force_group.description: Force all file operations to run as this group.

items.description: VFS modules specific to this share (overrides global).

vfs_modules.description: Per-share VFS modules, e.g., enable 'recycle' only for 'shared' files.

vfs_options.description: Key-value map of VFS module options. Each key is a module name; each value is a list of option strings (e.g., {'recycle': ['touch = true', 'versions = *.backup']}))

shares.description: List of shares to configure. Each share defines path, permissions, and optional VFS behavior.

items.description: Additional config file paths to include (e.g., '/etc/samba/smb.conf.local').

include_files.description: Extra config snippets (one per line) to include at end of smb.conf. Useful for AD integration or per-site customizations.
